page.layout: One printed page. Index in two parallel columns of entries with page numbers, from top to bottom: left column with the Latin entries and right column with the matching entries and page numbers. Running title "INDEX." at the top. No page number printed. Lower part of the page blank, with stains and show-through only.

page.notes: Right-hand column is partly obscured by a tear and damage along the right edge; entries there, including "pontifi=", "nti=", "mi=" and "grifaunt", are doubtful. The page number "3 71" beside "electus" is uncertain and marked [?]. "176.so" is read from a long-s-like form and may be an abbreviation. Faint marks in the lower right (small letters and signs, about 4 to 5 items) look like show-through or stains and were not transcribed. No catchword or signature is visible.
